_note: Fight, Flight or Freeze 02 'Bear in the camp' (12 Nov 2026): realistic sound effects, no blings or whooshes. Same pipeline as recipes.json (Stable Audio 3 Small SFX, local). Jonny: every sound realistic or close to it. 'label' = the CLAP label each cut is scored against. car-alarm, grass-fire and storm-wind are kind 'steady' (sustained noise: pick.py's event finder sees no events in it, so a patched pick.py cuts fixed windows of len[1] s and crossfades the 0.25 s tail into the head so the cut loops).
